expected_seq.description: Optional: the highest decision `seq` you read on these snapshots, or 0 when you read none. The call is refused with 409 `decided_since` when someone decided on one of them after that.

id.description: The UUID of a run of the pull request, not a snapshot `id`.

identifiers.description: Identifiers of the snapshots whose accept or reject to undo, on the run you pass as `id`.
